data.one_liner: Load system fonts (ttf/otf) on Windows, macOS, Linux for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: The package lets you load any system font by name or path and use it in Text widgets. It also provides utilities to list fonts and a selector widget.
use_when: You need to use a native OS font not bundled with the app
You want a quick way to preview and select system fonts in a Flutter UI
avoid_when: You need cross‑platform font fallback handling
strengths: Simple API, no build_runner, works on desktop
Supports loading all fonts or a specific directory
weaknesses: No font fallback or caching strategy
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, call SystemFonts().loadFont() in initState
